- **ADIPLS captures:** A0 glue-tap captures (adipls_oracles/run_mesa_captures.sh); sha256 `example_astero/a0tap/calls.tsv` `15169eecfec5`, `example_astero/a0tap/modes.tsv` `5247bbe845cc`, `fast_scan_grid/a0tap/calls.tsv` `0a07cdce353f`, `fast_scan_grid/a0tap/modes.tsv` `780366d6868b`, `fast_simplex/a0tap/calls.tsv` `03d5fde8db16`, `fast_simplex/a0tap/modes.tsv` `a146dd0059b6`.
- **FlexMESA:** `12c7627124c0`.

A call is one `get_modes(l)` (GYRE) or one per-model `adipls` call (ADIPLS). A call is fully bit-identical when it returns the same number of modes as MESA and every compared quantity of every mode has MESA's 64 bits. ULP distances are over binary64 bit patterns; for integer quantities the column gives the absolute difference.
